intent: Dismissible overlay for short tasks, forms, or extra detail. Not a must-choose confirm.

requirements: Title is the accessible name, description is aria-describedby when present
Unique ids via useId — do not hardcode modal-title

doNot: Do not invent local Modal, Dialog, or DialogTrigger
Do not use AlertDialog for dismissible work
Do not skip the close control unless showClose is false AND footer/body still provide a way out. Overlay click and Escape still close.
snippet: <Dialog open={open} title="Edit profile" description="Make changes to your profile." onClose={close} footer={<ButtonGroup ariaLabel="Dialog actions"><Button variant="secondary" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onClick={save}>Save</Button></ButtonGroup>}>...</Dialog>
